items.name: Finder
items.summary: A forward substring searcher that uses the Two-Way algorithm.

methods.name: find
methods.summary: Returns the first occurrence of `needle` in the given `haystack`, or `None` if no such occurrence could be found.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a searcher that finds occurrences of the given `needle`.

items.name: FinderRev
items.summary: A reverse substring searcher that uses the Two-Way algorithm.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a searcher that finds occurrences of the given `needle`.

methods.name: rfind
methods.summary: Returns the last occurrence of `needle` in the given `haystack`, or `None` if no such occurrence could be found.
